name: YuE
description: YuE2: frontier music generation with symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic music editing.
one_liner: Give it lyrics and a style, and it composes and sings a full original song — including turning an existing song into a cover in a totally different style.
buyer: A small business owner or ad agency that needs a custom jingle or background track but can't afford a composer or licensed stock music.
business_use_cases: A wedding or event planner offers a 'custom song from your love story' add-on, generated in a day instead of commissioned from a musician.
A YouTuber or TikTok creator generates royalty-free custom background music for every video instead of paying for stock licenses.
A small ad agency produces a custom jingle for a local business's radio spot in an afternoon instead of booking a studio.

money_ideas.idea: Sell one-off custom song commissions (weddings, birthdays, small-business jingles) for a flat fee.
Run a subscription 'unlimited royalty-free background music' service for content creators.

steal_this: Open a $75-per-song 'custom jingle for your business' storefront this weekend — take a business description, generate three options, deliver the best one.
